name: Frosted Glass
description: The phosphor-shell frosted panel look over a real blur. The scene behind the surface is blurred and tinted by a slowly turning two-colour gradient. A drifting crystalline grain and a soft vignette sit on top. Where nothing sits behind the surface it falls back to the original translucent gradient slab. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the pane.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the surface is blurred (px)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the frosted pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the blurred backdrop

parameters.name: Grain amount
parameters.description: Strength of the crystalline frost grain

parameters.name: Grain drift
parameters.description: How quickly the fine frost detail drifts, where 0 freezes it

parameters.name: Gradient strength
parameters.description: How much of the gradient colours is mixed over the blurred scene

parameters.name: Gradient speed
parameters.description: How quickly the gradient turns and drifts, where 0 freezes it

parameters.name: Vignette
parameters.description: How much the pane darkens toward its edges

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off for a pane that only rounds under a title bar

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge (px). Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation only where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours
